design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value for the analysis, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Matching text-readable full PDF has no explicit statement that ILSA sampling weights were omitted; weight references concern model parameters, outcome scaling, data variables or class/pixel weighting, not demonstrated sample-weight use.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without accounting for school clustering, as there is no mention of multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as splitting the data for model training, which does not qualify as validation beyond the estimation sample.
